meta.name: azure-enterprise-infra-planner
meta.description: Architect and provision enterprise Azure infrastructure from workload descriptions. For cloud architects and platform engineers planning networking, identity, security, compliance, and multi-resource topologies with WAF alignment. Generates Bicep or Terraform directly (no azd). WHEN: 'plan Azure infrastructure', 'architect Azure landing zone', 'design hub-spoke network', 'plan multi-region DR topology', 'set up VNets firewalls and private endpoints', 'subscription-scope Bicep deployment', 'Azure Backup for VM workloads'. PREFER azure-prepare FOR app-centric workflows.

copy.tagline: 根据工作描述生成可部署的 Azure 基础设施代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果负责 Azure 基础设施的规划与搭建,想直接从业务描述生成可部署代码。
copy.tagline_en: Generate deployable Azure infrastructure code from workload descriptions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a cloud architect who wants to generate Azure infrastructure code from workload descriptions.

howto.what: 装上后，当用户描述 Azure 工作负载或架构需求时，Claude 会按 7 阶段流程完成调研、规划与验证，并直接生成 Bicep 或 Terraform 代码（不使用 azd），部署前必须得到用户确认。
howto.when: 当你说“规划 Azure 基础设施”“设计 hub-spoke 网络”“多区域灾备”等架构需求，或要求生成 Bicep/Terraform 代码时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划企业 Azure 登陆区，包括订阅划分和 RBAC。
say.note: Claude 会进入 7 阶段流程并产出基础设施计划。

say.text: 设计一个 hub-spoke 网络，带防火墙和私有端点。
为我的多区域灾备架构生成 Terraform 代码。
say.note: 先调研和规划，再在确认后部署。

howto.what_en: Claude plans Azure infra from workload descriptions, runs a 7-phase gated pipeline, and generates Bicep/Terraform directly (no azd), covering networking, identity, security, compliance; deploys after user approval.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to plan Azure infrastructure, architect a landing zone, design a hub-spoke network, or similar architecture/deployment requests.

say_en.text: Help me plan an enterprise Azure landing zone with RBAC.
say_en.note: Claude runs the pipeline and produces an infra plan.

say_en.text: Design a hub-spoke network with firewalls and private endpoints.
Generate Terraform code for multi-region disaster recovery.
say_en.note: Researches and plans first, then deploys after confirmation.
